business_summary: Toho Gas Co., Ltd. engages in the gas, LPG and other energy, electric power, and other businesses in Japan and internationally. The company is involved in the extraction and trade of natural gas and other energy resources; sale of coke, tar products, petroleum products, paving materials, automobiles, daily necessities, food, and beverages; design, supervision, and construction of civil engineering, architectural, electrical, plumbing, and machinery installation works; and sale, leasing, and management of real estate. It also manufactures, transports, and sells high-pressure gases, including liquefied natural gas, liquefied petroleum gas, and liquefied carbon dioxide; gas appliances, air conditioning equipment, kitchen equipment, water supply and drainage equipment, and household electrical appliances; and methanol and plasticizers. In addition, the company engages in the design, manufacture, and sale of air pollution prevention equipment, water pollution prevention equipment, and waste treatment equipment for environmental conservation; soil regeneration treatment; production, sale, and rental of computer-related hardware and software; and sale and rental of crime prevention and disaster prevention equipment. Further, it provides information processing and provision services, communication services, and security services, as well as surveys, research, and consulting services. Additionally, the company is involved in the management of cooking classes, cultural classes, sports facilities, hot spring facilities, training facilities, rental conference rooms, and accommodation facilities; restaurant business and travel agency business; general leasing, finance, advertising, labor dispatch and truck transportation; and non-life insurance agency and life insurance solicitation businesses. Toho Gas Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1922 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.
